shortDescription: Category 3 Hurricane Isaias made landfall near Destin, Florida, the US National Hurricane Center said in its latest advisory on Friday.The hurricane, packing maximum sustained winds of 105 mph (165 kph), is about 50 miles (80 km) west-northwest of Panama City, Florida, the center said.
